Let the light of Christ shine in our School
Welcome to St Anne's Catholic Primary School
It is my great pleasure, on behalf of the children, governors and staff, to welcome you to the family of St. Anne’s Catholic Primary School in Lambeth.
We hope that the information provided on our website will help you to gain an understanding of our expectation for high standards, our school mission and of our Gospel values.
St. Anne’s is a happy, vibrant, multicultural and multi-faith community with a strong commitment to ensure that Christ is at the centre of all we do.

pageCache.text:
Science Week at St Anne's
Science Experiments in Science Art DT room.
During Science week our pupils have become forensic scientists. They have been analysing fingerprints to solve the mystery of the Headteacher's missing Medal - hopefully they will find out who has taken it.
You have not allowed cookies and this content may contain cookies.
If you would like to view this content please Allow Cookies Cookie Settings
Children were also asked to research their favourite scientist and share some interesting facts they learned about them.
Here are just a few of the competition nominations.
We are very proud of all the children's hard work!
